lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Adding a new screen at the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and was stopped early.
Home wait_info changes (8 tests) were helpful in three significant wins, though five tests showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), and modifying finish layouts (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence for most other specific kinds of change remains thin because few categories have at least two agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Live Desktop Docking Status Stream
candidates.change: Display a detailed live progress breakdown detailing desktop asset loading, pet rigging, and screen anchor registration on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The home stage has a high mean duration of 2336s, and previous home wait_info tests produced three significant conversion wins.

wait_status.text: Your pet will anchor to your desktop taskbar when ready.

guard.reason: Valid waiting screen details update within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes have strong historical evidence of significant wins.

candidates.title: Hero Story & Path Selection Split Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen into a split layout previewing interactive pet behaviors alongside path selection.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a huge mean time of 514s (median 8s) and a 20.6% drop-off rate, showing users need clearer motivation before picking a path.

intro_story.text: Meet your future desktop companion in real-time

guard.reason: 'story.replace.intro_story[0]': a preview cannot do the intro_story job (use ['animation', 'button', 'image', 'mascot', 'text', 'video'])

candidates.title: Pre-Selection Companion Teaser Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new visual teaser screen before path selection showcasing animated pet desktop interactions.
candidates.why: Over 20% of users leave at path selection; establishing early visual delight before choosing a path builds engagement.

new_companion_teaser.headline: Your Desktop Is About to Get Lively
new_companion_teaser.body: See how your pet will walk on your taskbar, react to windows, and keep you company.

guard.reason: Adding a new teaser screen inside onboarding flow is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens consistently hurt performance and was stopped early in prior tests.

candidates.title: Account Preservation Sign-In Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen layout with explicit account persistence guarantees and recovery badges.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users, and support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save & Sync Your Pet Across Reboots
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your custom pet safe and accessible anytime on this computer.

sign_in_options.text: Prevents accidental pet reset when re-opening the desktop app.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Readiness Alert & Status
candidates.change: Add desktop background generation badge indicators and optional completion desktop alerts during assembly.
candidates.why: Home generation step takes a mean of 2336s; clear status and alerts prevent users from assuming the app froze.

waiting.hint: You can minimize this window! We will alert you on desktop when ready.

guard.reason: Waiting screen updates maintain pet creation feedback.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes are proven levers for mitigating long wait duration friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Quick-Guide Copy
candidates.change: Update finish headline and copy to explicitly explain how to locate, click, and interact with the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users unable to find the pet on desktop and 3 emails confused about controlling or hiding it.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at the bottom right corner of your screen. Click your pet to talk, or right-click the tray icon to adjust settings.

guard.reason: Home intro copy update provides clear controls explanation.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from both funnel and support emails, but copy changes on finish have mixed historical results.

candidates.title: Split-View Pet Friend Chooser Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the friend picker screen with a split layout showing a live companion animation alongside choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is only 66.2% with a mean duration of 1017s. Live interactive feedback streamlines friend selection.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign-In Stall Diagnostic Hint & Retry
candidates.change: Display a fallback diagnostic hint and quick auth retry button if sign-in takes longer than expected.
candidates.why: Support logged 2 tickets where the sign-in screen stalled or failed to appear, contributing to the 27.1% sign-in drop-off.

sign_in.hint: Connection taking longer than expected? Click retry below to reload auth options.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.components[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Stamp Showcase Layout
candidates.change: Change the adoption certificate screen layout to spotlight style with a prominent verification seal.
candidates.why: 33.8% of users drop off during adoption; highlighting official registration provides satisfying feedback.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new companion is officially registered and bound to your computer session.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.official_stamp' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'badge', 'image'] with an asset:stamp/ asset

candidates.title: First-Day Companion Starter Gift Incentive
candidates.change: Add a starter reward badge component to the home intro screen granting immediate accessory unlocks.
candidates.why: The finish step has a 29.1% drop-off rate and 5815s mean duration; an immediate gift incentive encourages finishing setup.

home_welcome.text: Welcome Gift Unlocked: Starter Toy & Treat Pack!

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a badge cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Adding a new screen at the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and was stopped early.
Home wait_info changes (9 tests) were helpful in three significant wins, though six tests showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), modifying finish layouts (2 tests), and changing finish copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence for most other specific kinds of change remains thin because few categories have at least two agreeing tests.
